title: Wan 2.1 VACE 14B Canny restyle
description: Local edge-conditioned restyle on the 14B VACE model. Not offered in the workspace: on 2026-10-24 the installed local FP8 conversion loaded (16.5 GB staged) but produced corrupted output on a clean 480x848 comparison, while the 1.3B route on the same clip and prompt stayed coherent. Re-qualify the weights before making this route selectable.

values.prompt: Black-and-white film noir, hard directional key light, deep shadows, soft haze, 1950s cinematography.
Warm golden-hour sunlight, long soft shadows, amber highlights, gentle lens flare, cinematic color grade.
Night scene lit by neon signage, cyan and warm practical lights, wet reflective ground, shallow depth of field.
Hand-painted animation look, soft brush edges, visible canvas texture, muted storybook palette.

requirements.instructions: Install the UMT5 XXL FP8 scaled text encoder.

evidence: Benchmark 2026-10-24, run 10c45fdb-967b-4519-9113-e732c017c893: the local FP8 14B weights staged 16,538 MB and completed 480x848/17 frames, but the output is high-frequency colour noise with no recognisable subject. The 1.3B control on the same clip, prompt and seed (run 2930d2bc-c396-4ac5-88be-0e59281b2848) produced a coherent watercolour restyle. The 14B route is therefore experimental and hidden from the picker.
